Game Overview

In Hungry Box, the core idea is straightforward: guide a daring box in its relentless pursuit of a glowing green orb by creating platforms with precision. Balance strategy and reflexes in this endless 2D platformer, keeping the box from perilous falls and walls. Challenge yourself for higher scores and unlock new skins as you master the art of navigation.
